{
  "name": "missioncache",
  "displayName": "MissionCache",
  "version": "1.0.40",
  "description": "Project memory that survives compaction. The plan, decisions, gotchas and next steps live in markdown files and reload with one command. One lead session watches the rest.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Tomer Brami"
  },
  "homepage": "https://missioncache.dev",
  "repository": "https://github.com/missioncache/missioncache.git",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "memory",
    "context",
    "compaction",
    "project-management",
    "multi-session",
    "time-tracking"
  ],
  "mcpServers": {
    "pm": {
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "uvx",
      "args": [
        "--from",
        "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mcp-server",
        "--with",
        "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/missioncache-db",
        "mcp-missioncache"
      ]
    }
  },
  "documentationUrl": "https://missioncache.dev/docs/",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/missioncache/missioncache/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://missioncache.dev/docs/privacy/"
}
